P.text: When a user queues a withdrawal of kHYPE tokens via queueWithdrawal, the exchange rate at queue time is used to determine how much HYPE they can withdraw; after the minimum withdrawal period (7 days minimum) the user can confirm via confirmWithdrawal, which calls _processConfirmation.
P.evidence_quote: When a user queues a withdrawal of kHYPE tokens via the queueWithdrawal function, they provide the kHYPE amount they want to withdraw. The exchange rate is then used to determine how much HYPE token they can withdraw.

I.text: The exchange rate used to determine the HYPE amount on withdrawal confirmation should reflect the exchange rate at confirmation time, not the rate from when the withdrawal was queued.
I.evidence_quote: the protocol uses the exchange rate from when the withdrawal was queued rather than when it is confirmed to determine how much HYPE token they receive

V.text: The protocol uses the HYPE amount calculated during queue (at least 7 days old) at confirmation, allowing users to profit if the exchange rate decreases between queue and confirmation, extracting value from the protocol and creating bank run/insolvency risk.
V.evidence_quote: the protocol uses the hype amount calculated during queue, which is at least 7 days old, allowing users to profit if the exchange rate decreases during this period.
